plan: Drive: from District of Tumbler Ridge, about 80 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.53259, -121.23307, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 1.8 km E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 122 m, about 48 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2016 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-21, Region 7B. Season: mule deer 4 point bucks Nov 1 to Nov 30 and more rows (synopsis page 62, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
